versions.localizedDescription:
Riverside is a powerful podcast and video maker that allows you to record and edit video and audio easily. 

With AI features like captions, transcription, and teleprompter, and capabilities like text-based editing and studio-quality recording, you can publish top-notch videos, podcasts and social media clips from anywhere, anytime.

Join thousands of podcasters, media companies, influencers and online content creators who trust Riverside for high-definition video and audio. Whether you're making a podcast or a video tutorial, or editing your next Instagram Reel or TikTok video, all you need is your phone and the Riverside app.

Key Features:
PRO quality recordings: Capture individual HD audio and video tracks for up to 10 participants at
